H2_calibration.quote: General federal false-statement law might apply to certified reports, but the Act doesn't say so.
H2_calibration.note: Also item 6 notes the catch-all is open to vagueness and nondelegation challenges.

H4_grandfather_step.quote: Because the cutoff is enactment, licenses issued at any point while the bill is pending, including after markup, would be permanently grandfathered. That creates an incentive to obtain licenses before enactment.
